concept.title: Turning Plug & charge (PnC) on or off

conbody.p: When charging using Plug & charge (PnC), the PnC contract is installed during charging. Select Electric VehiclePlug & charge menu on the infotainment system to enable or disable PnC contract management.

li.p: Within the PnC contract, contract company information and expiry date (year/month) are displayed.
You can delete the contract by pressing 'Delete contract' button.

note.p: If you do not have a PnC contract, we recommend that you turn off the Plug & charge (PnC) function. If you leave the Plug & charge (PnC) function on without signing a contract, problems may occur during charging.
